SELECT fish_date_doy, SUM(yt) as total_yt, COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as num_boats, COUNT(*) as num_trips FROM trips WHERE yt > 0 GROUP BY fish_date_doy ORDER BY total_yt DESC LIMIT 15
